purpose: Reader-facing Christianity branch guide derived from canonical lineage/event data. Dates are rupture, consolidation or formation markers unless explicitly documented as institutional founding dates.
rules: Do not imply one church was created ex nihilo on a council/schism date when its community predates that marker.
Distinguish communion, denomination, reform movement and cross-denominational current.
State doctrinal differences descriptively, using the tradition's own formulations where possible.
A family-tree edge describes historical relation, not theological legitimacy or superiority.
